main_text.l: CHRISTVS Seruator nostèr, paulo ante quàm in crucem ageretur, & hostium qui in ipsius necem conspirauerant, cum praesentiret atque expectaret aduentum: quos tum secum habebat Apostolos, de insidijs quas in ipsos Sathan struxerat, elegati admodum & diserta loquendi forma commonefecit: Sa-thanas (inquit) expetiuit ut ventilaret atq; cerneret uos uelut triticum. Significantissime profecto perennis istius humani gene-ris hostis indefessum studium in regno ipsius oppugnando, & si qua posset ratione expu-gnando, expresit. Non est aut quod quisquam arbitretur, grauissimam illam senten-tiam ad illud tantum temporis quo dicta fuit momentum, & quod tum instabat periculū pertinere. Quisquis enim sic interpretanda esse cesuerit praeceptoris istius coelestis verba, maximam Euangelicae doctrinae partem ie-iunam sterilemq; reddet: quae alioqui plena atq; foecunda est utilissimarum saluberrima-rumq; commonefactionum, & consolationum. Nam coniuratus ille omnium piorum hostis, de odio in ipsos, decq; nocedi atq; per-dendi

page.notes: Woodcut initial C (framed, with figures) at the start of the first paragraph; joined to HRISTVS as CHRISTVS. The printed stamp of the Bayerische Staatsbibliothek München at the top is excluded. "CANDIDOQVE": the Q has a swash and the reading is uncertain. "S." after LECTORI may read "S+" in print. Printed "cesuerit" and "expresit" are kept as printed. The final catchword "dendi" is the first word of the next page, and the signature is "a 2".
